body.query:
query PublisherSearch(
    $country: Country
    $networkKey: ID
    $q: String
    $isEndorsed: Boolean
    $limit: Int
    $offset: Int
  ) {
    list: organizationSearch(
      isEndorsed: $isEndorsed
      country: $country
      networkKey: $networkKey
      q: $q
      offset: $offset
      limit: $limit
    ) {
      limit
      count
      offset
      results {
        key
        title
        created
        country
        logoUrl
        excerpt
      }
    }
  }
